And what is a clock cycle of a chip? At baseline, it's worth observing

A key thing you need to do whenever you have massive parallelism is synchronize

expensive synchronization methods like a mutex. One thread will finish what it's doing,

On chips, we take a very different approach. Every nanosecond or so, all circuitry in the chip

The entire chip typically goes in lockstep to the next operation in one fell swoop.
